exposure: amalgamation of two medium sized obstetric units
opening of a Midwifery Led Unit (MLU)
outcome: Moderate to severe hypoxaemic ischaemic encephalopathy (HIE) rates
cohort: Births at a tertiary referral center for fetal and maternal medicine with 6000 births/year
finding: Reconfiguration of maternity services, including the amalgamation of obstetric units and the opening of an MLU, was associated with improved intrapartum outcomes, including reduced CS and HIE rates.
